Source.value: Migration entry; superunion.com now 301 redirects to designbridge.com (merged Jan 2023)

AI Notes.value: Superunion launched Jan 2018 as a WPP merger of five consultancies: Brand Union, The Partners, Lambie-Nairn, Addison, and VBAT. Around 750 staff across 23 offices at peak, billing over $100m. Core capabilities: brand strategy, identity systems, motion graphics, packaging, corporate communications. Merged with Design Bridge in Jan 2023 to form Design Bridge and Partners (approx 850 staff, 12 countries); the Superunion brand was retired. Entry reflects the legacy Superunion entity; current operations sit under Design Bridge and Partners (designbridge.com). Size 100+ confirmed, WPP-owned agency. Country: multi-office per legacy record (UK HQ, US, Hong Kong).
